## 3. Technology Stack & Quality Standards

- **Design**: Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve Studio
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cloud Firestore
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Render, AWS, Cloudflare, Google Cloud Platform
- **SEO & Compliance**: Schema.org JSON-LD, Semantic HTML5, WCAG 2.1 Accessibility, Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms)
